While each stays open, anyone with this link can see where you where you are while it is on, and this person can see where you are right now. Which steps should come first? You must first deal with recovery and devices so others cannot get back in or approve sign-ins. While open, you can check notes or plan offline. Close access quickly to stop unwanted watchers from seeing your daily life.
arguments.stay_hidden: We should stay hidden and wait for a better time to make changes. If you act now, they may notice several things. If you remove signed-in devices, whoever uses them will see they are signed out. If you stop sharing location or map links, they will see your location stop updating, or they may notice when they open the link. If you change recovery phones or emails, codes may still go to the old numbers and addresses for seven days. If you remove mail access, forwarding, or filters, they may notice the copies stop coming or that mail stops reaching them. If you leave family groups or household plans, they will see who is in the group or lose shared benefits. Please delay these steps and screenshot your findings first.
